messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] how can plot qtls on linkage map
parts:
If you just want to add dots (perhaps with different colors) to the genetic map, I'd just call points().
In the plot from plot.map, the x-axis locations of the chromosomes are 1, 2, ..., n_chr.

Here's an example using the hyper data.

data(hyper)
out <- scanone(calc.genoprob(hyper, step=1))
qtl <- summary(out, threshold=3)

plotMap(hyper, shift=FALSE) # shift=FALSE to _not_ move starting marker to 0 cM
for(i in 1:nrow(qtl)) {
whchr <- match(qtl[i,1], chrnames(hyper))
points(whchr+0.4, qtl[i,2], pch=21, bg="slateblue")
}

karl
